title: Spyglass: Now Live and Ready!
summary: We're excited to announce the full launch of Spyglass, empowering you with a powerful new tool for deeper insights.

title: Introducing Advanced File Management

title: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We are thrilled to introduce our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past successes, ongoing developments, and future innovations.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes easier to use, more beautiful, and seamlessly integrated them into your workflow.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our enhanced collaboration features, making real-time co-creation more intuitive and efficient for everyone.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Experience seamless collaboration as you now effortlessly find and interact with all shared items from your connections, making teamwork more productive than ever.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive support for global languages, broadening our reach and inclusivity.

summary: We're making Noeko's codebase open source, empowering our community with maximum control and direct involvement in shaping its future, while fostering complete transparency.

title: Intelligent Knowledge Explorer
summary: Uncover deeper insights and streamline your workflow by applying powerful filters for tags, time, and shared items to your dynamic knowledge graph.

title: Powerful Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Discover exactly what you need by applying advanced filters and sorting options, then save these tailored searches as personalized collections for instant access and curated insights.

title: Enhanced Content Linking

summary: Empower your organization with Noeko's new self-hosting capability, granting complete control over your data and infrastructure, alongside flexible premium plans packed with advanced features.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with New Themes
summary: We're refining our current themes and introducing an array of stunning new options to personalize your workspace.

title: Timely Welcome Messages
summary: Experience a truly personalized welcome as your homepage greetings now precisely match the actual time of day.

title: Efficient List Actions and Direct Item Management
